title: 橋梁逐跨預鑄節塊架設~Span-by-span precast bridge erection
focus: 以架橋機整跨懸吊預鑄節塊、一次張拉體外鋼腱，讓長距離高架橋以每跨數天的節奏重複推進~Hanging a whole span of precast segments from a gantry and stressing external tendons at once, so long viaducts advance at a few days per span
summary: 從簡支箱梁的正彎矩與體外預力需求出發，計算架橋機對橋墩的施工荷載，再處理乾接縫與環氧接縫、轉向塊與錨碇橫隔、架橋機推進穩定、整跨荷重轉換與預製場幾何控制，最後以鋼腱振動頻率、接縫監測與可更換性驗收交接，並以佛州 Long Key 橋、Seven Mile 橋與曼谷 Bang Na 高架道路為案例。~Starting from the sagging moment and external prestress demand of a simple-span box girder, compute gantry construction loads on the piers, then handle dry and epoxy joints, deviators and anchorage diaphragms, gantry launching stability, whole-span load transfer and casting-yard geometry control, and finally accept and hand over with tendon vibration checks, joint monitoring and replaceability, using Florida's Long Key and Seven Mile bridges and Bangkok's Bang Na Expressway as cases.

units.anchor: 整跨箱梁與體外鋼腱~Whole-span box and external tendons
units.title: 逐跨工法的結構系統與預力需求~Structural system and prestress demand of span-by-span erection
units.mechanism: 逐跨工法把一整跨的預鑄節塊（常見 10 至 14 塊）同時懸吊或擱置在架橋機或下承桁架上，調整線形後一次張拉縱向鋼腱，使整跨立刻成為能自承重的簡支梁，再把架橋機推到下一跨。因為所有節塊在張拉前都由臨時結構承托，接縫在施工期不需承受懸臂彎矩，箱梁可以用等高度斷面，最適合跨度約 30 至 45 m、跨數很多的長距離高架橋。鋼腱多採體外配置，沿箱內由錨碇橫隔經轉向塊折線布設，近似拋物線的偏心抵抗跨中正彎矩。~Span-by-span erection hangs or rests a whole span of precast segments, commonly 10 to 14, on an overhead gantry or underslung truss, aligns them, then stresses the longitudinal tendons in one operation so the span immediately becomes a self-supporting simple beam before the gantry moves on. Because all segments are carried by temporary works until stressing, the joints never carry cantilever moment during construction and the box can have constant depth, ideal for long viaducts with many spans of about 30 to 45 m. Tendons are usually external, running inside the box from anchorage diaphragm to deviators in a polygonal profile whose eccentricity approximates a parabola to resist midspan sagging moment.
units.model: 簡支跨 L = 42 m、自重 w = 180 kN/m：M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m；加鋪面 50 kN/m 的 11,025 kN·m 與活載 12,000 kN·m，合計 M = 62,715 kN·m。斷面 A = 7.2 m²、S_b = 4.0 m³、跨中偏心 e = 1.0 m，底緣保留 0.7 MPa 壓應力：P ≥ (62,715/4.0 + 700)/(1/7.2 + 1.0/4.0) ≈ 42,120 kN，取 12 束 × 3,600 kN = 43,200 kN。數值為教學假設。~Simple span L = 42 m, self-weight w = 180 kN/m: M_DL = wL²/8 = 39,690 kN·m; adding 11,025 kN·m from 50 kN/m surfacing and 12,000 kN·m of live load gives M = 62,715 kN·m. With A = 7.2 m², S_b = 4.0 m³, midspan eccentricity e = 1.0 m and 0.7 MPa residual bottom compression, P ≥ (62,715/4.0 + 700)/(1/7.2 + 1.0/4.0) ≈ 42,120 kN; use 12 tendons × 3,600 kN = 43,200 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以施工階段模型檢查三個狀態：節塊懸吊於架橋機（梁體無預力）、張拉完成後架橋機卸載（自重加預力）、營運滿載（含鋪面與活載），每個狀態列出每一接縫上下緣應力，確認接縫在所有使用狀態都維持設計規定的殘餘壓應力。~Check three states in a construction-stage model: segments hanging from the gantry with no prestress, after stressing with the gantry unloaded (self-weight plus prestress), and full service load with surfacing and live load, listing top and bottom stresses at every joint and confirming that each joint keeps the specified residual compression in all service states.
units.failure: 若把預鑄節塊箱梁當作一般連續鋼筋混凝土梁設計，忽略接縫處沒有連續鋼筋，活載下跨中接縫會張開，雨水與鹽分直接進入箱內，體外鋼腱錨頭與轉向塊加速腐蝕。~Designing a precast segmental box like an ordinary reinforced girder, ignoring that no reinforcement crosses the joints, lets midspan joints open under live load so rain and salt enter the box and accelerate corrosion at external tendon anchors and deviators.
units.misconception: 逐跨架設的節塊接縫在營運時可以像鋼筋混凝土一樣容許開裂。~Joints in span-by-span segmental spans may crack in service just like reinforced concrete.
units.practice: 設計圖說應明列每一跨的節塊編號、鋼腱編號與張拉順序，並註明接縫殘餘壓應力的設計值，作為施工與日後評估的共同基準。~Drawings should list segment numbers, tendon numbers and stressing order for every span and state the design residual joint compression, as a shared basis for construction and later assessment.

units.anchor: 架橋機支腿反力~Gantry leg reactions
units.title: 架橋機與橋墩的施工期荷載~Gantry construction loads on the piers
units.mechanism: 整跨節塊在張拉前全部重量經由架橋機傳到前後兩座橋墩，架橋機自重也一併加上；支腿通常放在墩帽或已完成箱梁的端部，與墩柱軸線有偏心，墩柱在施工期承受營運時不會出現的單側彎矩。架橋機推進時重心沿縱向移動，風力又作用在高聳的主桁與節塊上，所以墩帽承壓、墩柱彎矩、基礎與支承臨時鎖定都要以施工荷載逐一檢核，而不是只套用營運荷載組合。~Before stressing, the entire weight of a span of segments, plus the gantry's own weight, passes through the gantry to the two piers; legs usually sit on the pier cap or on the end of the completed girder, eccentric to the column axis, so the column carries one-sided bending that never occurs in service. As the gantry launches, its centre of gravity moves along the bridge and wind acts on the tall girders and hanging segments, so pier-cap bearing, column bending, foundations and temporary bearing locks must each be checked for construction loads rather than service combinations alone.
units.model: 一跨節塊 W = 180×42 = 7,560 kN，架橋機在該跨的自重 4,000 kN，兩支腿平均反力 R = (7,560 + 4,000)/2 = 5,780 kN；支腿距墩軸偏心 1.2 m 時墩柱施工彎矩 M = 5,780×1.2 ≈ 6,936 kN·m，須與墩柱設計彎矩與基礎承載比較。數值為教學假設。~One span of segments weighs W = 180×42 = 7,560 kN and the gantry contributes 4,000 kN over that span, so each of the two legs carries on average R = (7,560 + 4,000)/2 = 5,780 kN; with a 1.2 m leg eccentricity from the pier axis the construction moment in the column is M = 5,780×1.2 ≈ 6,936 kN·m, to be compared with the column and foundation capacity. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 架橋機供應商須提供各工況（空載推進、懸吊整跨、張拉、颱風停機）的支腿反力表，由橋梁設計單位對照墩帽、墩柱與基礎容量逐項確認；首跨架設時在支腿下設荷重計或以油壓讀值監測實際反力，與表列值比較。~The gantry supplier must provide leg-reaction tables for each case (empty launch, full span hanging, stressing, storm parking), which the bridge designer checks against pier-cap, column and foundation capacity item by item; on the first span, monitor real reactions with load cells or hydraulic readings under the legs and compare with the table.
units.failure: 支腿落在墩帽邊緣或未經設計的位置，可能壓碎墩帽混凝土或使支承墊石開裂；若颱風停機時未鎖定架橋機並降低懸吊荷重，側風可能使架橋機橫移甚至倒塌，砸毀已完成的跨。~Legs landing near the edge of a pier cap or at an undesigned position can crush the cap concrete or crack bearing plinths; if the gantry is not locked and unloaded when parked for a typhoon, cross-wind can slide or topple it onto completed spans.
units.misconception: 架橋機的荷重只是暫時的，橋墩照營運荷載設計就足夠。~Gantry loads are only temporary, so piers designed for service loads are always sufficient.
units.practice: 把架橋機支腿位置、最大反力與停機條件（例如風速上限）寫入橋墩設計說明與施工計畫，任何更換架橋機或改變支腿位置都需重新送審。~Write gantry leg positions, maximum reactions and parking conditions, such as a wind-speed limit, into the pier design notes and the construction plan, and require resubmission for any change of gantry or leg position.

units.anchor: 剪力鍵與乾接縫~Shear keys and dry joints
units.title: 匹配澆注接縫：乾接縫與環氧接縫~Match-cast joints: dry and epoxy
units.mechanism: 逐跨工法的節塊在預製場以匹配澆注製作，相鄰節塊端面完全吻合，並設多重剪力鍵。佛州 Long Key 橋與曼谷 Bang Na 高架道路採用乾接縫，完全依靠體外預力壓緊接縫與剪力鍵傳遞剪力；許多新近規範則要求環氧接縫，用以密封接縫、填補微小不平並在架設時潤滑定位。乾接縫施工快、不受天候影響，但接縫沒有任何抗拉能力，也不能防水，因此需要較高的殘餘壓應力與更好的箱內防水。~Span-by-span segments are match-cast in the yard, so the faces of adjacent segments fit exactly and carry multiple shear keys. Florida's Long Key Bridge and Bangkok's Bang Na Expressway used dry joints, relying entirely on external prestress to clamp the joints so shear keys transfer shear; many recent specifications require epoxy joints instead, to seal the joint, fill small irregularities and lubricate alignment during erection. Dry joints are fast and weather-independent, but they have no tensile capacity and no water-tightness, so they need higher residual compression and better waterproofing of the box.
units.model: 支點剪力 V = 180×42/2 + 50×42/2 + 1,500 = 6,330 kN。若腹板範圍分擔 30% 預力，摩擦係數 μ = 0.6，接縫摩擦抗剪 V_f = 0.6×0.3×43,200 ≈ 7,776 kN，比值 7,776/6,330 ≈ 1.23（未計剪力鍵貢獻）。數值為教學假設。~Support shear V = 180×42/2 + 50×42/2 + 1,500 = 6,330 kN. If the webs carry 30% of the prestress and μ = 0.6, joint friction resistance is V_f = 0.6×0.3×43,200 ≈ 7,776 kN, a ratio of 7,776/6,330 ≈ 1.23 before counting shear keys. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 預製場每一節塊拆模後檢查剪力鍵完整性與端面清潔，架設前做乾接合試拼；環氧接縫則記錄批號、溫度與適用時間，並檢查擠出是否沿全周連續。張拉後以塞尺抽查接縫是否完全閉合，任何開口都要記錄位置與深度。~In the yard, inspect shear-key integrity and face cleanliness after each segment is stripped, and dry-fit before erection; for epoxy joints, record lot, temperature and pot life and check that squeeze-out is continuous round the perimeter. After stressing, spot-check joint closure with feeler gauges and record the location and depth of any opening.
units.failure: 剪力鍵在運輸或吊裝時崩角而未修補，接縫局部承壓集中，張拉時可能進一步崩裂；乾接縫若殘餘壓應力不足，重車通過時接縫反覆微開，箱內積水沿底板流向錨碇區，成為腐蝕源頭。~Shear keys chipped in transport or lifting and left unrepaired concentrate bearing and can spall further during stressing; dry joints with too little residual compression breathe open under heavy trucks, letting water collect inside the box and run along the bottom slab to the anchorages, starting corrosion.
units.misconception: 乾接縫只是少塗一層環氧，結構行為與環氧接縫完全相同。~A dry joint is just an epoxy joint without the epoxy and behaves identically.
units.practice: 接縫型式（乾或環氧）、最低殘餘壓應力、剪力鍵修補程序與箱內排水設計應在招標文件中一次訂定，施工中不得以趕工為由由環氧改為乾接縫。~Specify joint type (dry or epoxy), minimum residual compression, shear-key repair procedure and box drainage in the tender documents, and forbid switching from epoxy to dry joints during construction to save time.

units.anchor: 轉向塊與錨碇橫隔~Deviators and anchorage diaphragms
units.title: 體外鋼腱的轉向塊與錨碇~Deviators and anchorages for external tendons
units.mechanism: 體外鋼腱位於箱梁內部但不埋在混凝土中，只在端部錨碇橫隔與跨內轉向塊與結構接觸。鋼腱在轉向塊轉折時，會對轉向塊施加向上與向內的集中力，轉向塊必須以鋼筋把這股力吊掛回腹板與頂板；錨碇橫隔則要把整束鋼腱的集中力擴散到整個箱梁斷面。轉向處預埋彎曲鋼管，彎曲半徑與出口喇叭口要能避免鋼絞線在邊緣受到尖角磨損。~External tendons run inside the box but are not embedded in concrete; they touch the structure only at end anchorage diaphragms and intermediate deviators. Where a tendon changes direction at a deviator it pushes upward and inward with a concentrated force that the deviator reinforcement must hang back into the webs and top slab, while the anchorage diaphragm must spread the full tendon force into the whole box section. Deviators contain preformed curved steel pipes whose radius and flared exits prevent strands from being nicked on sharp edges.
units.model: 轉向力 F = 2P·sin(θ/2)。每束張拉時 P = 3,711 kN、轉角 θ = 0.10 rad：F = 2×3,711×sin(0.05) ≈ 371 kN；一側腹板 6 束合計約 2,226 kN，轉向塊吊筋須以此力加上設計放大係數配置。數值為教學假設。~Deviation force F = 2P·sin(θ/2). With P = 3,711 kN per tendon at jacking and θ = 0.10 rad, F = 2×3,711×sin(0.05) ≈ 371 kN; six tendons on one web give about 2,226 kN, which the deviator hanger reinforcement must carry with the design load factor. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 預製轉向塊節塊時，以三維量測確認預埋彎管的進出口座標與角度，與鋼腱線形圖比對；張拉後檢查轉向塊周邊混凝土是否出現放射狀或沿腹板的裂縫，並記錄寬度作為基準。~When casting deviator segments, survey the entry and exit coordinates and angles of the curved pipes in 3D and compare them with the tendon profile drawings; after stressing, inspect concrete around deviators for radial cracks or cracks along the webs and record widths as a baseline.
units.failure: 彎管角度或位置錯誤使鋼腱在出口處形成尖角折線，鋼絞線外層 HDPE 套管被磨破，長期振動下套管破損處成為腐蝕點；轉向塊吊筋不足則在張拉時把轉向塊從腹板拉出裂縫。~A pipe set at the wrong angle or position kinks the tendon at the exit, wearing through the HDPE sheath, and under long-term vibration the damaged sheath becomes a corrosion point; insufficient hanger reinforcement lets the stressing force crack the deviator away from the web.
units.misconception: 體外鋼腱不埋在混凝土裡，所以轉向塊只需要很少的鋼筋。~Because external tendons are not embedded, deviators need very little reinforcement.
units.practice: 轉向塊與錨碇節塊屬於關鍵節塊，預製時應有專屬檢查表（彎管座標、鋼筋、混凝土強度），並保留量測紀錄隨節塊編號歸檔；彎管出口須有圓滑過渡並經監造逐一確認。~Deviator and anchorage segments are critical segments that need dedicated checklists in the yard (pipe coordinates, reinforcement, concrete strength), with survey records filed under each segment number; pipe exits must have smooth transitions confirmed one by one by the supervising engineer.

units.anchor: 架橋機推進穩定~Gantry launching stability
units.title: 架橋機推進、懸臂與防傾覆~Gantry launching, cantilevering and overturning
units.mechanism: 架橋機完成一跨後，要把主桁推向下一座橋墩：推進過程中主桁前端有一段很長的懸臂，重心必須始終位於後支點之內，否則整機前傾。推進時通常先把前支腿收起，主桁以後支點與中支點滑移，到達下一墩後放下前支腿，再移動後支腿。推進作業的風速限制、縱坡與彎道造成的側向分力、以及支腿與墩頂的錨定，都是決定能否安全推進的條件。~After completing a span, the gantry girder must be pushed to the next pier; during launching its front end becomes a long cantilever, and the centre of gravity must always stay inside the rear support or the machine tips forward. The front leg is usually lifted, the girder slides on rear and middle supports, the front leg is lowered on reaching the next pier, and then the rear leg is moved. Wind-speed limits, longitudinal gradient, lateral components on curves and the anchorage of legs to the pier top all decide whether launching is safe.
units.model: 主桁均布重 q = 60 kN/m，後段 50 m、前懸臂 42 m：傾覆彎矩 M_o = 60×42²/2 = 52,920 kN·m，抵抗彎矩 M_r = 60×50²/2 = 75,000 kN·m，安全係數 75,000/52,920 ≈ 1.42。若要求 1.5，需增加 1.5×52,920 − 75,000 = 4,380 kN·m，於後端 50 m 處加配重 4,380/50 ≈ 88 kN。數值為教學假設。~With a girder weight q = 60 kN/m, 50 m behind the pivot and a 42 m front cantilever: overturning moment M_o = 60×42²/2 = 52,920 kN·m, restoring moment M_r = 60×50²/2 = 75,000 kN·m, factor 75,000/52,920 ≈ 1.42. To reach 1.5, add 1.5×52,920 − 75,000 = 4,380 kN·m, i.e. a counterweight of 4,380/50 ≈ 88 kN at the rear end. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 推進前依檢查表確認：風速低於上限、支腿與軌道錨定、配重位置、液壓與制動系統、前支腿與下一墩的對位標記；推進中由專人監看前端下撓與後支點反力讀值，若反力接近零（將失去抵抗）立即停止。~Before launching, a checklist confirms wind below the limit, leg and rail anchorage, counterweight position, hydraulic and braking systems, and alignment marks between the front leg and the next pier; during launching an assigned person watches front-end deflection and rear-support reaction readings, and stops immediately if the rear reaction approaches zero.
units.failure: 推進時忘記把上一跨的配重或吊具移回後端，或在超過風速限制時強行推進，主桁前傾觸及下一墩或墜落；在彎道或縱坡上推進而未設側向與下滑止擋，也曾導致架橋機滑移出軌。~Forgetting to move counterweights or lifting gear back after the previous span, or pushing beyond the wind limit, can tip the girder onto the next pier or drop it; launching on curves or gradients without lateral and downhill stops has also let gantries slide off their rails.
units.misconception: 架橋機本身很重，所以推進時不可能傾覆。~A gantry is so heavy that it cannot overturn while launching.
units.practice: 架橋機的組立、首次推進與每次推進列為停留點，須由架橋機設計者提供推進程序與安全係數計算，並由專業技師與監造簽認；颱風季應訂定停機錨定程序與撤離條件。~Gantry assembly, first launch and every launch are hold points; the gantry designer must provide the launching procedure and stability calculation, signed off by a qualified engineer and the supervising engineer, and a parking, anchoring and evacuation procedure is set for the typhoon season.

units.anchor: 整跨荷重轉換~Whole-span load transfer
units.title: 整跨組裝、張拉與荷重轉換~Span assembly, stressing and load transfer
units.mechanism: 節塊依序吊掛到架橋機後，先以吊桿或千斤頂調整每一塊的高程、橫坡與接縫間隙，使整跨符合預定的預拱線形；墩頂常留一道現澆濕接縫吸收累積誤差。張拉完成時，梁體因預力上拱而逐漸離開吊桿，荷重從架橋機轉移到永久支承。若轉換過程不同步，部分吊桿突然卸載或過載，梁端支承也可能一端先受力，造成扭轉與支承偏壓。~Segments are hung on the gantry in sequence, and hangers or jacks adjust each one's level, cross-fall and joint gap so the span follows the intended camber; a cast-in-place wet joint at the pier often absorbs accumulated error. As stressing completes, the girder cambers up off the hangers and its weight transfers from the gantry to the permanent bearings. If the transfer is not synchronised, some hangers unload or overload suddenly and one end bearing may pick up load first, causing twist and uneven bearing pressure.
units.model: 以等偏心近似，預力上拱 δ_P = P·e·L²/(8EI)，自重下撓 δ_g = 5wL⁴/(384EI)。EI = 35,000 MPa × 3.0 m⁴ = 1.05×10⁸ kN·m²：δ_P = 43,200×1.0×42²/(8×1.05×10⁸) ≈ 90.7 mm，δ_g = 5×180×42⁴/(384×1.05×10⁸) ≈ 69.5 mm，淨上拱約 21 mm，表示梁體會自行離開吊桿。數值為教學假設。~With a constant-eccentricity approximation, prestress camber δ_P = P·e·L²/(8EI) and self-weight deflection δ_g = 5wL⁴/(384EI). For EI = 35,000 MPa × 3.0 m⁴ = 1.05×10⁸ kN·m², δ_P = 43,200×1.0×42²/(8×1.05×10⁸) ≈ 90.7 mm and δ_g = 5×180×42⁴/(384×1.05×10⁸) ≈ 69.5 mm, a net upward camber of about 21 mm, so the girder lifts itself off the hangers. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 張拉依設計順序左右對稱分級進行，每一級記錄吊桿荷重、梁端高程與跨中高程；最終淨上拱與計算值比較（例如偏差超過 ±20% 即暫停查明），並確認四個支承都已受力、無懸空。~Stress symmetrically in design order and in stages, recording hanger loads, end levels and midspan level at each stage; compare the final net camber with calculation, pausing to investigate if it deviates by more than, for example, ±20%, and confirm all four bearings carry load with none hanging free.
units.failure: 若單側鋼腱先全部張拉，箱梁產生側彎與扭轉，接縫一側張開；支承墊石高程不一時，張拉後一個支承懸空，梁體成為三點支承，在活載下搖動並使支承與墊石受衝擊損壞。~Stressing all tendons on one side first bends and twists the box sideways and opens joints on one side; uneven plinth levels leave one bearing unloaded after stressing, so the span rocks on three supports under traffic, hammering and damaging bearings and plinths.
units.misconception: 張拉完成後只要拆除吊桿，荷重自然會平均傳到四個支承。~After stressing, removing the hangers automatically shares the load equally among the four bearings.
units.practice: 架設程序書要包含節塊吊掛順序、線形調整允差、濕接縫澆置條件、張拉順序與吊桿卸載步驟，荷重轉換列為停留點；支承墊石高程在架設前複測並留下紀錄。~The erection procedure should include segment hanging order, alignment tolerances, wet-joint casting conditions, stressing order and hanger release steps, with load transfer as a hold point; bearing plinth levels are re-surveyed and recorded before erection.

units.anchor: 預製場匹配幾何~Casting-yard match geometry
units.title: 短線匹配澆注與平面曲線控制~Short-line match casting and curve control
units.mechanism: 大量逐跨節塊多在短線法預製台座生產：固定端模不動，前一節塊作為匹配節塊移到相對位置，再澆製新節塊。平面曲線、縱坡與超高都靠每次調整匹配節塊的位置與角度來達成，所以預製場幾何控制其實是在把橋梁的三維線形分解成每一個接縫的微小轉角。Bang Na 高架道路的預製場設有約 100 個澆注台座，月產能約 1,800 個節塊，量測與資料管理的規模與一般工程截然不同。~High-volume span-by-span segments are usually produced on short-line casting cells: the bulkhead stays fixed while the previously cast segment is moved into a relative position as the match-cast unit and the new segment is cast against it. Horizontal curves, gradients and superelevation are created by adjusting the position and angle of the match-cast unit each time, so yard geometry control decomposes the bridge's 3D alignment into small rotations at every joint. The Bang Na Expressway yard had about 100 casting cells with a capacity of about 1,800 segments per month, a scale of surveying and data management very different from ordinary jobs.
units.model: 平曲線半徑 R = 600 m、節塊長 s = 3.0 m：每接縫轉角 θ = s/R = 0.005 rad，節塊遠端相對切線的偏移 s²/(2R) = 9/1,200 = 7.5 mm；42 m 整跨的弦長與弧線中點差 L²/(8R) = 42²/4,800 ≈ 368 mm，決定箱內體外鋼腱與支承的平面位置。數值為教學假設。~For a horizontal radius R = 600 m and segment length s = 3.0 m, each joint turns θ = s/R = 0.005 rad and the far end of a segment is offset s²/(2R) = 9/1,200 = 7.5 mm from the tangent; over a 42 m span the arc departs from the chord by L²/(8R) = 42²/4,800 ≈ 368 mm at midspan, which fixes the plan positions of external tendons and bearings. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每一節塊澆置前後由測量塔與固定控制點量測頂板控制點，計算實際轉角並與理論值比較，將誤差回饋到下一節塊的匹配位置（誤差不可累積）；每跨完成後計算整跨實際幾何，與設計線形比對並調整濕接縫。~Before and after each cast, survey top-slab control points from the survey tower and fixed benchmarks, compute the actual rotation and compare it with theory, feeding the error back into the next match position so errors do not accumulate; after each span, compute the as-cast span geometry, compare it with the design alignment and adjust the wet joint.
units.failure: 若預製場只照理論座標擺放匹配節塊而不回饋實測誤差，誤差逐塊累積，到現場整跨無法對準支承或下一跨，只能加大濕接縫或修鑿節塊，甚至報廢重做。~Placing match units by theoretical coordinates without feeding back measured errors lets errors accumulate segment by segment, so on site the span misses its bearings or the next span and needs a wider wet joint, grinding, or even a scrapped segment.
units.misconception: 預製場的模板精度夠高，就不需要逐塊量測幾何。~If the yard forms are accurate enough, segment geometry need not be surveyed one by one.
units.practice: 預製場應有獨立的幾何控制工程師與專用軟體，每節塊產出一份經簽認的幾何紀錄並以節塊編號追蹤到架設位置；測量塔與控制點每月複核穩定性。~The yard needs an independent geometry-control engineer and dedicated software, with a signed geometry record for every segment traced by segment number to its erected position; survey towers and benchmarks are checked for stability monthly.

units.anchor: 體外鋼腱振動頻率~External tendon vibration frequency
units.title: 體外鋼腱力量的驗收量測~Acceptance measurement of external tendon force
units.mechanism: 體外鋼腱在轉向塊之間是一段自由的張緊索，它的橫向自然頻率與張力直接相關，因此可以在張拉後以加速度計輕敲量測頻率，反算每一束的有效力，作為千斤頂讀值與伸長量之外的第三種獨立驗證。這個方法也能在營運期重複使用，追蹤預力損失或發現斷絲。量測需考慮套管與灌漿質量、端部約束與鋼腱抗彎勁度的影響，最好先以舉離試驗校正。~Between deviators an external tendon is a free taut cable whose lateral natural frequency relates directly to its tension, so after stressing a light tap and an accelerometer give the frequency and hence the effective force of every tendon, a third independent check beyond jack readings and elongation. The same method can be repeated in service to track prestress loss or detect broken wires. The measurement must account for the mass of sheath and grout, end restraint and tendon bending stiffness, ideally calibrated first by a lift-off test.
units.model: 張緊弦 T = 4·m·L²·f²。鋼腱含套管與灌漿 m = 31 kg/m、自由長 L = 10 m，實測基頻 f = 17.0 Hz：T = 4×31×10²×17.0² ≈ 3,584 kN，與設計有效力 3,600 kN 相差約 −0.4%。若頻率降為 16.0 Hz，T ≈ 3,174 kN，即損失約 12%。數值為教學假設。~Taut string T = 4·m·L²·f². For a tendon with sheath and grout m = 31 kg/m, free length L = 10 m and measured fundamental f = 17.0 Hz, T = 4×31×10²×17.0² ≈ 3,584 kN, about −0.4% from the 3,600 kN design effective force. A frequency of 16.0 Hz would give T ≈ 3,174 kN, a loss of about 12%. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 對每一跨所有體外鋼腱量測頻率並換算張力，與張拉紀錄比較；同一跨內各束差異超過設定門檻（例如 ±5%）時，以舉離試驗或補充量測確認，並把頻率基準值寫入竣工資料，供日後定期檢查比對。~Measure frequencies of all external tendons in each span and convert them to forces, compare with the stressing records, and if tendons in a span differ by more than a set threshold, for example ±5%, confirm by lift-off or further measurement; record baseline frequencies in the as-built file for later periodic comparison.
units.failure: 若只用千斤頂讀值驗收而不量測個別鋼腱，某一束錨具滑絲或夾片未咬合的問題可能被掩蓋，日後該束力量明顯偏低，接縫殘餘壓應力不足而開始張開。~Accepting only on jack readings, without measuring individual tendons, can hide a tendon whose strands slipped or whose wedges did not bite, leaving it well below force so that joint residual compression falls short and joints begin to open.
units.misconception: 體外鋼腱張拉完成後力量不會改變，所以不需要再量測。~Once stressed, an external tendon's force never changes, so it need not be measured again.
units.practice: 竣工資料要以表格列出每一束鋼腱的編號、張拉力、伸長量、量測頻率與換算張力，並說明量測時的溫度與校正方法，讓維護單位能用同一方法重測。~As-built records should tabulate every tendon's number, jacking force, elongation, measured frequency and derived force, with the temperature and calibration method, so the maintenance team can repeat the same measurement.

units.anchor: 斷束後接縫殘餘壓應力~Joint compression after tendon loss
units.title: 體外鋼腱防蝕與可更換設計~Corrosion protection and replaceability of external tendons
units.mechanism: 體外鋼腱的優點是看得到、可更換，但它的防蝕完全依賴 HDPE 套管、灌漿或填充材與錨頭保護蓋；套管破裂或灌漿有空洞時，水分與氯離子會在低點積聚，鋼絞線可在多年內腐蝕斷裂。1990 年代末至 2000 年前後，佛州數座分段橋的體外鋼腱曾因灌漿空洞與滲水而發現斷束，促成灌漿材料與施工規範的全面修訂。設計時必須假設某一束可能失效或需要更換，檢查其餘鋼腱是否仍能維持接縫受壓。~External tendons are visible and replaceable, but their corrosion protection depends entirely on the HDPE sheath, the grout or filler and the anchor caps; with a cracked sheath or grout voids, water and chlorides collect at low points and strands can corrode and break within years. Around the late 1990s and 2000, failed external tendons were found in several Florida segmental bridges with grout voids and water ingress, prompting broad revisions of grout materials and construction specifications. Design must assume that any one tendon may fail or need replacing and check that the rest still keep the joints in compression.
units.model: 12 束時底緣應力：P/A = 43,200/7.2 = 6,000 kPa、Pe/S_b = 10,800 kPa、自重與鋪面 −12,679 kPa，殘餘 4,121 kPa，消壓活載彎矩 4,121×4.0 ≈ 16,485 kN·m > 12,000。若少 1 束（39,600 kN），殘餘降為 2,721 kPa，消壓彎矩約 10,885 kN·m < 12,000，滿載時接縫會張開。數值為教學假設。~With 12 tendons the bottom-fibre stresses are P/A = 43,200/7.2 = 6,000 kPa, Pe/S_b = 10,800 kPa and −12,679 kPa from self-weight and surfacing, leaving 4,121 kPa, so the live-load decompression moment is 4,121×4.0 ≈ 16,485 kN·m > 12,000. With one tendon lost (39,600 kN) the residual falls to 2,721 kPa and the decompression moment to about 10,885 kN·m < 12,000, so joints open under full live load. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 竣工前以內視鏡或敲擊抽查錨頭後方與低點的灌漿飽滿度，檢查套管接頭、熱熔焊口與錨頭保護蓋；更換程序的可行性（千斤頂空間、錨碇拆除與鋼腱抽出路徑）在交接前以實際尺寸確認一次。~Before completion, spot-check grout fullness behind anchors and at low points by borescope or sounding, and inspect sheath couplers, fusion welds and anchor caps; confirm the feasibility of the replacement procedure, including jack clearance, anchor removal and tendon withdrawal path, with real dimensions once before handover.
units.failure: 箱內排水不良使雨水在錨碇橫隔前積存，錨頭保護蓋與套管接頭長期泡水，鋼絞線在錨具後方腐蝕斷裂；若設計沒有考慮單束失效，斷束後接縫殘餘壓應力不足，整跨必須限載直到更換完成。~Poor box drainage lets rainwater pond in front of anchorage diaphragms so anchor caps and sheath joints sit in water for years and strands corrode and break behind the anchors; if design did not consider single-tendon loss, the remaining joint compression is insufficient and the whole span must be load-restricted until replacement.
units.misconception: 體外鋼腱有 HDPE 套管保護，所以不會腐蝕。~External tendons in HDPE sheaths cannot corrode.
units.practice: 設計須檢核任一束鋼腱失效或更換時的接縫狀態並規定更換期間的交通限制；採購規格要求經認證的預力系統與灌漿材料，灌漿作業由合格人員執行並保留逐束紀錄。~Design must check joint behaviour with any one tendon lost or under replacement and state the traffic restrictions during replacement; procurement requires certified post-tensioning systems and grout, with grouting by qualified personnel and records kept tendon by tendon.

units.anchor: 接縫監測基準~Joint monitoring baseline
units.title: 接縫行為監測與工程交接~Joint behaviour monitoring and handover
units.mechanism: 逐跨預鑄橋的健康狀態主要反映在接縫：只要接縫保持受壓，梁體就近似一根完整的預力梁；接縫一旦在活載下張開，底緣應變會出現非線性跳增，接縫處的位移計會讀到開口。因此交接時應在代表性跨的跨中接縫裝設應變計與位移計，以已知重量的車輛做一次基準量測，日後定期重測比較，就能判斷預力是否流失或接縫是否開始呼吸。~The health of a span-by-span precast bridge shows mainly at its joints: as long as they stay in compression the girder behaves like a monolithic prestressed beam, but once a joint opens under live load the bottom-fibre strain jumps non-linearly and a displacement gauge across the joint reads an opening. Handover should therefore install strain and displacement gauges at midspan joints of representative spans, take a baseline with vehicles of known weight, and repeat periodically to tell whether prestress has been lost or joints have started to breathe.
units.model: 接縫受壓時，活載彎矩 12,000 kN·m 造成底緣應變 ε = M/(S_b·E) = 12,000/(4.0×35×10⁶) ≈ 86 με；若同一載重下量到約 120 με 並伴隨跨接縫位移計讀值，代表接縫已局部張開。數值為教學假設。~While the joint stays compressed, a live-load moment of 12,000 kN·m produces a bottom-fibre strain ε = M/(S_b·E) = 12,000/(4.0×35×10⁶) ≈ 86 με; measuring about 120 με under the same load, together with a reading on the gauge across the joint, indicates the joint has partly opened. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 基準量測使用已知軸重的試驗車，以慢速與正常速度各通過數次，記錄應變、位移與溫度；量測結果與計算值的比值（量測／計算）應在可解釋範圍內，並將感測器位置、車重與原始資料一併納入交接文件。~The baseline uses test trucks of known axle loads crossing several times at crawl and normal speed, recording strain, displacement and temperature; the measured-to-calculated ratio must be explainable, and sensor locations, truck weights and raw data go into the handover documents.
units.failure: 沒有基準資料時，多年後在接縫看到白華或滲水痕跡，也無法判斷是排水問題還是預力流失；等到底板出現沿接縫的明顯開口，往往已有鋼腱斷束，修復代價遠高於早期介入。~Without a baseline, efflorescence or seepage at a joint years later cannot be attributed to drainage or to prestress loss; by the time an obvious opening appears along the bottom slab, tendons have often already failed and repair costs far exceed early intervention.
units.misconception: 接縫出現滲水只是防水問題，與結構無關。~Water seeping at a segment joint is only a waterproofing issue with no structural meaning.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含節塊與鋼腱編號對照、預製幾何紀錄、張拉與頻率量測表、接縫監測基準、箱內通行與排水維護計畫，以及鋼腱更換程序；首次定期檢查應在通車約一年內完成。~Handover documents should include segment and tendon cross-references, casting geometry records, stressing and frequency tables, the joint monitoring baseline, box access and drainage maintenance plans and the tendon replacement procedure; the first routine inspection should be done within about a year of opening.

example: 工程規劃練習：一條 12.6 km 的高架橋採 42 m 簡支跨，共 12,600/42 = 300 跨，每跨 14 個節塊，總計 300×14 = 4,200 個節塊。若每部架橋機每 2.5 天完成一跨（含推進），單部需要 300×2.5 = 750 個工作天；投入 3 部架橋機則約 250 個工作天。供料需求為 3×14/2.5 = 16.8 個節塊／天，若每個短線台座每天產出 1 個節塊，至少需要 17 個台座，另加故障與養護餘裕。為吸收颱風或運輸中斷，堆置場若要儲備 30 天用量，需容納約 30×16.8 ≈ 504 個節塊。若架設循環變為 3 天／跨，總工期增為 300×3/3 = 300 天，日需求降為 3×14/3 = 14 個節塊。這說明逐跨工法的關鍵路徑常在預製與運輸，而不只是架設本身。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際工程的計畫。~Planning exercise: a 12.6 km viaduct with 42 m simple spans has 12,600/42 = 300 spans; at 14 segments per span it needs 300×14 = 4,200 segments. If each gantry completes a span every 2.5 days including launching, one gantry needs 300×2.5 = 750 working days; three gantries need about 250. Supply demand is 3×14/2.5 = 16.8 segments per day, so with one segment per short-line cell per day at least 17 cells are needed, plus margin for breakdowns and curing. To ride out a typhoon or transport stoppage with 30 days of buffer, the storage yard must hold about 30×16.8 ≈ 504 segments. If the erection cycle slips to 3 days per span, the duration grows to 300×3/3 = 300 days while daily demand drops to 3×14/3 = 14 segments. This shows that the critical path of span-by-span work often lies in casting and transport, not only in erection. Values are teaching assumptions, not the plan of any real project.
history: 法國在 1960 年代發展出匹配澆注預鑄節塊與架橋機，Oléron 高架橋（1964–1966）首度使用架橋機。Jean Muller 與 FIGG 在佛州 Keys 群島把逐跨工法推向成熟：Long Key 橋以約 36 m 的跨度在架設桁架上逐跨組裝，節塊長約 5.5 m，平均每週約 2.5 跨，並採乾接縫與箱內體外鋼腱；1982 年完工的新 Seven Mile 橋以類似設計建造，完工時是世界最長的預鑄節塊橋。2000 年通車的曼谷 Bang Na 高架道路長約 55 km，以匹配澆注、乾接縫與體外鋼腱逐跨架設，展示了工廠化預製的規模。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~France developed match-cast precast segments and launching gantries in the 1960s, and the Oléron Viaduct (1964–1966) was the first to use a gantry. Jean Muller and FIGG brought span-by-span erection to maturity in the Florida Keys: the Long Key Bridge was assembled span by span on an erection truss with spans of about 36 m and segments about 5.5 m long, averaging about 2.5 spans a week, with dry joints and external tendons inside the box; the new Seven Mile Bridge, completed in 1982 on a similar design, was then the world's longest precast segmental bridge. Bangkok's Bang Na Expressway, opened in 2000 and about 55 km long, was erected span by span with match-cast dry joints and external tendons, demonstrating factory-scale precasting. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: Long Key 橋共 103 跨，標準跨約 36 m（118 ft）~The Long Key Bridge has 103 spans with a typical span of about 36 m (118 ft)
Long Key 橋節塊長約 5.5 m（18 ft），平均每週架設約 2.5 跨，最多 5 跨~Long Key Bridge segments were about 5.5 m (18 ft) long, erected at an average of about 2.5 spans per week and up to 5
新 Seven Mile 橋 1982 年完工，共 440 跨，最大跨約 41 m（135 ft），全長約 10.9 km~The new Seven Mile Bridge opened in 1982 with 440 spans, a longest span of about 41 m (135 ft) and a length of about 10.9 km

ASBI 指出逐跨工法適用跨度約至 150 ft（約 45 m）~ASBI gives span-by-span erection as suitable for spans up to about 150 ft (about 45 m)
亞特蘭大 MARTA 高架橋 1983 年完工，最大跨約 43 m，以雙三角桁架逐跨架設~Atlanta's MARTA viaduct, completed in 1983, had a maximum span of about 43 m erected span by span on twin triangular trusses
